author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
- Add ShellConfigManager for managing shell configurations with localStorage persistence.
- Introduce configuration types and interfaces for better type safety.
- Create a test suite for ShellConfigManager covering initialization, value retrieval, updates, validation, and persistence.
- Implement default configuration values and validation logic for user preferences.
- Support for exporting and importing configurations with metadata.
- Add change listeners for configuration updates and ensure graceful error handling.

Closes #945.
title: feat(moo-dang): Implement configuration management
